observed.dict_delegation: BaseModel.dict returns dict(self._iter(...)) and passes by_alias plus exclude_unset directly into _iter.
observed.exclude_unset_filter: _iter delegates allowed-key selection to _calculate_keys; when exclude_unset is true, _calculate_keys begins from a copy of self.__fields_set__ rather than all __dict__ keys.
observed.serialization_key_selection: For each canonical field_key in __dict__, _iter emits self.__fields__[field_key].alias when by_alias is true and the key is a declared field; otherwise it emits field_key itself.
